faqs.q: Sec. 30-8. - Return of excess monetary contributions and contributions in kind.
faqs.a:
(a)
For purposes of this section, the term "receipt" shall mean the date upon which the
               candidate knows or reasonably should know that an excess monetary contribution or
               contribution in kind has been received.
(b)
In the event a candidate receives monetary contributions or contributions in kind
               which exceeds the aggregate limit set forth in
section 30-7
, such candidate shall make a good faith attempt to return the excess amount to the
               contributor by personally returning the excess amount or by placing the excess contribution
               in the U.S. mail with a complete address and sufficient postage. The good faith attempt
               to return an excess contribution shall take place no later than seven days following
               the receipt of such excess contribution.
(Code 1981, § 11-8; Ord. No. 3511, § 2, 2-1-1999)
